apps.name: P2Pme
apps.subtitle: Direct private photo backup & Wi-Fi sync
apps.localizedDescription:
P2Pme gives you complete ownership of your photos. Sync and back up camera roll photos directly to your Android server or PC with zero cloud intermediaries.

• Continuous automated photo backup
• End-to-end encrypted direct Wi-Fi and WebRTC transfer
• Zero cloud storage, 100% private

permissions.usageDescription: Allows automatic camera roll backup directly to your private home storage.
Discovers nearby P2Pme receivers and 24/7 home servers on your Wi-Fi network.

versions.localizedDescription: Resilio-style Camera Roll continuous auto-backup on iOS, native PhotoKit integration, official Google Photos-themed iOS app icon, and 1-tap AltStore in-app update.
